title: Analysis code: In silico perturbation of single-cell gene regulatory networks identifies transcription factors governing M2 macrophage polarization in hepatocellular carcinoma
description: R code implementing an in silico TF perturbation framework for single-cell RNA-seq data: Seurat processing of GSE140228 and GSE149614, GENIE3 gene regulatory network inference, random walk with restart (RWR) using every candidate TF as an individual seed node, regulatory impact scoring on a 13-gene M2 signature [score(TF) = (1/|M2|) * sum_{g in M2} pi_g(TF)], 1,000 TF-label permutations with standardized effect sizes and Benjamini-Hochberg correction, ranking-stability analysis across restart probabilities, and monocle3 pseudotime reconstruction. Companion code for the manuscript submitted to Life (MDPI).
notes: Zenodo reads this file automatically when a GitHub release is archived. Replace the placeholder creator names/affiliation and, once the manuscript is published, add the DOI of the article under related_identifiers with relation 'isSupplementTo'.
